user.title: Clean Energy
user.description: Monitors energy sensors for anomalous spikes and corrects long-term statistics. Set the maximum realistic power draw for any single sensor. After install, additional sensors are added automatically when a spike is detected, or manually via the `clean_energy.monitor_sensor` service.
